description_en: Removes an episode from an episode list
kebab_example: aliyun live remove-show-from-show-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveShowFromShowList

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the shows to delete
parameters.name: show_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the LIVE console, find the production studio name in the LIVE console by choosing LIVE Console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The show ID.

Obtain the ShowId from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848051.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
节目ID。
通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848051.html接口的返回参数获取ShowId值
parameters.name: show_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete shows in a batch. Valid values:

true: Deletes shows in a batch.

false: Deletes a single show.

If you do not specify this parameter or leave it empty, a single show is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否批量删除节目。取值：

true：批量删除。

false：单个删除。

该参数不填，取值为空时，也表示单个删除
parameters.name: is_batch_mode

failedList.description_en: A list of IDs of the shows that failed to be deleted and the failure information
failedList.description_zh: 删除失败的节目ID列表以及失败信息

successfulShowIds.description_en: The IDs of the shows that were successfully deleted
